title: RAF pilots encounter Aurora over the North Sea

tellings.quote: he had talked to pilots who had encountered the Aurora in the North Sea

plain: British Royal Air Force pilots are said to have come across the Aurora, a rumoured secret American spy plane, over the North Sea, sometime between the late 1980s and the late 1990s. The aviation journalist Nick Cook passes this on second-hand: he says a contact of his, an RAF pilot he does not name, had talked to pilots who met the aircraft there. If true, it would mean a secret plane was flying where foreign military pilots could see it.
